items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore suffered a shoulder injury (believed AC joint sprain) Thursday night, ruled OUT for the game vs Lions after landing hard; doctors do not consider it serious, day-to-day with a chance but not a lock to play next week vs Chargers.
items.why: Shoulder injury/stinger from dive attempt; X-rays, ruled out mid-game; AC sprain not serious per sources.
items.implication: Missed TNF production; monitor for Week 3 availability. Bills WR depth elevated short-term.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wednesday practice (history of missing 5 games in 2024 on hammy); MRI results key. Ran 37/42 routes last week. Grade 1 strain, DNP Thursday, status in jeopardy vs Bengals though not serious per docs.
items.why: Hamstring tweak in practice; Grade 1 per reports; DNP/limited follow-up; Schefter confirms jeopardy but not serious.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 2; if OUT, targets redistribute to Boutte/Hutchinson/Noel/Schultz. Monitor Friday report.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets vacuum if absent; Dalton Schultz low-end TE1 upside.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go' after missing Week 1 (ankle); unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but timing perfect with AJ Brown IR and strong upcoming matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF/LV etc before bye).
items.why: Self-reported ready; Pats desperate for explosives post-Brown IR; schedule soft.
items.implication: Potential committee or lead role expansion; monitor snaps/carries/routes vs Stevenson. Explosive upside.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, red-zone if earns share; handcuff value elevated.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday due to last week's knee surgery (meniscus); has yet to practice since procedure.
items.why: Post-meniscectomy; no practice participation yet; team cautious.
items.implication: Likely OUT Week 2; Michael Mayer fringe TE1 if absent. Return possible Week 3-4.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (rib injury from Week 1 hit); making it unlikely he plays Sunday vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury; consecutive DNPs; Harbaugh day-to-day but practice absence damning.
items.implication: Expect OUT or limited; Quentin Johnston primary beneficiary for targets/routes.
items.opportunity: Johnston role expansion; deep-league Tre Harris.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP second straight practice Thursday; Ja'Kobi Lane on IR (wrist). If Flowers OUT vs Saints, Ravens WR order: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Chris Moore.
items.why: Hamstring re-aggravation; consecutive DNPs; Lane already IR.
items.implication: Flowers day-to-day, elevated miss risk; Bateman primary flex/start candidate if OUT. Andrews target bump possible.
items.opportunity: Bateman routes/targets; reverse if Flowers unexpectedly ACTIVE.

items.text: Week 2 waivers highlight injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller. Also streaming and One Injury Away lists.
items.implication: Priority adds for depth/spot starts; precise handcuffs.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in Chiefs debut, 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q (74% snaps); Indy just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. Massive season range including RB1 overall if healthy.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage (targets + touches); soft run matchup.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 in Week 1 under Kubiak (tied Bijan for lead); 19% career tgt share recent, 25+ touches in 3/4 last. Overreaction to injury scare likely.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with upside; trust role.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: Career-high 26% tgt share, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB red-zone touches in Week 1; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC. RB9 util.
items.why: Passing-game + RZ dominance over Gainwell; soft run D.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN despite tough Week 1: 27% tgt share, 13.7 aDOT, 3 deep looks; TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR to Jets WRs, 6th-most PPG to WRs recently.
items.why: Strong volume/depth of target; favorable matchup.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career games with Wentz. Bears D allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Elite share with Wentz; matchup soft.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rush attempts Week 1, 69% fantasy pts via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further; Saints 8.5-pt dogs not run-friendly.
items.implication: Sit/flex down; Miller beneficiary if Kamara limited.

items.text: HATE: Marvin Harrison Jr. (8% tgt share Week 1, 5th on team, 0 RZ, tough SEA D); Brian Thomas Jr. (@ DEN tough perimeter D + shoulder limited); Harold Fannin (14% tgt lowest since W5 last yr, low aDOT, low team total).
items.why: Poor Week 1 usage + tough matchups/injury nicks.
